title: `Core\Http\TlsInfo::expiry` is a fatal for a peer whose `notAfter` is `99991231235959Z`.
text: RFC 5280 § 4.1.2.5 names exactly that date for a certificate with no end, and `Core\Time\Instant` ends before it, so [`nvs_core_http_tls_info_expiry`] has no instant to return. Whether it returns the last instant or an error a program can catch is a design call no record makes yet; `Core\Test::tlsSession` cannot build such a leaf, so only a peer, or a Rust test with an `rcgen` leaf, reaches it.
